chunks: And in another narration: “She is to be given eighty lashes.”

key_terms.تُضْرَبُ: she is to be struck, meaning she is to receive lashes as punishment
key_terms.ثَمَانِينَ: eighty, specifying the number of lashes

ai.seo_question: What punishment is mentioned in another narration for this case?
ai.summary: This report conveys a legal ruling specifying a punishment of eighty lashes. It appears in the context of jurisprudential discussion on prescribed and discretionary punishments related to illicit sexual conduct.
